data.one_liner: Obfuscates Dart enums into zero-cost extension types to eliminate metadata from binaries.
data.what_it_does: Generates zero-overhead extension types from private enums using high-entropy integers. It removes enum names from compiled AOT binaries to protect against reverse engineering tools like Ghidra and Blutter.
use_when: You want to prevent reverse engineering of app enums and business logic constants.
You need pattern matching and safe parsing for obfuscated enum states.
avoid_when: You require traditional reflection or runtime metadata access on enums.
You do not use code generation tools in your development workflow.
strengths: Removes enum identifier strings entirely from compiled AOT binaries.
Zero runtime overhead using extension types over primitive integers.
Compile-time exhaustiveness guarantees and safe parsing.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation steps.
Enums must be defined privately with special annotations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_dev dependencies and running build_runner code generation.
